facts.statement: The animal belongs to the genus Dianosuchus.
The genus was described by Young in 1982.
The species is named Dianosuchus changchiawaensis.
Dianosuchus is a member of the family Protosuchidae.
Dianosuchus is classified as a reptile.
Fossils date to the Sinemurian stage of the Early Jurassic.
facts.quote: dating back to the Sinemurian stage of the Early Jurassic

facts.statement: The animal lived between 199.5 and 192.9 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Sinemurian to Sinemurian (199.5 to 192.9 million years ago)

facts.statement: Fossils were found in the Dark Red Beds of the Lower Lufeng Formation in Yunnan, China.
facts.quote: Fossils have been found from the Dark Red Beds of the Lower Lufeng Formation in Yunnan, China

facts.statement: Its teeth were conical and isodont, lacking striations.
facts.quote: conical isodont teeth that lacked striations

facts.statement: It possessed very small antorbital fenestrae.

rejected.statement: It had an unusually flattened snout compared to other protosuchians.
rejected.quote: It is characterized by an unusually flattened snout compared to other protosuchians
